description: This file defines the FPGMPruner class, a specific type of structured sparsifier that implements filter pruning via geometric median for convolutional neural networks. It includes methods for computing distances between filters and updating pruning masks accordingly.

classes.name: FPGMPruner
classes.description: A class implementing filter pruning via geometric median (FPGM) structured pruning technique for CNNs.
